description: Relayed anonymous transfers a public owner signs. A signer reads every published slot opened, a co-owner names its notes against the notes its wallet holds, and every public leg of the frame equals a leg of its terms in order. ringPolicy is the ring account in hex. Each case holds the owner's terms, what its wallet knows, the message Ring RPC answers with, and the MessageMismatch the Rust ExpectedPublicOwner and the TypeScript check return. Frames carry zeroed proofs.
